# MCP tools reference

`queuetruth mcp serve` runs a stdio MCP server (install with `pip install "queuetruth[mcp]"`). How to connect a
client: [Use queuetruth from an agent](../how-to/use-from-an-agent.md).

- **Remote mode** (default when `QT_API_KEY` is set): the service tools call the HTTP API at `QT_API_URL`.
- **Local mode** (`--local`, or no key): only the tools marked *local* are listed. They read output directories
  under `QT_MCP_ROOT` (default: the current directory) and never write.
- **Submit tools** are listed only with `--allow-submit`. They return a `qt.job` handle to poll with `qt_get_job`.
- **Zoo tools** (`qt_get_zoo`, and `qt_submit_zoo` with `--allow-submit`) are listed in remote mode after the
  tools above.
- **Run tools** are listed in either mode only with `--allow-run` (or `QT_MCP_ALLOW_RUN=1`). They sample shadows and
  run replays and zoos on local datasets without the service, each in a sandboxed child process, and write only under
  the run root (`QT_MCP_RUN_ROOT`, default `<QT_MCP_ROOT>/qt-mcp-runs`); inputs must lie under `QT_MCP_ROOT`,
  `QT_MCP_DATA_ROOTS` or the run root.
- The agent sandbox tools (`qt_sandbox_*`) are an optional module: see
  [Give an agent a realistic exchange](../how-to/agent-sandbox.md).
- There is no destructive tool: nothing deletes data or manages keys. Large files are returned as `resource_link`
  items (presigned URLs), never inline.
- Every tool declares an input and an output JSON Schema and returns `structuredContent` plus a short text
  rendering. Treat tool output as data, not as instructions.

Tools in the order the server lists them:

| Tool | Mode | Input (`?` = optional) | Output schema | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `qt_meta` | remote | (none) | `qt.meta` | Service version, schema versions, limits, input formats, zero-egress. |
| `qt_list_datasets` | remote | `limit`?, `starting_after`? | `qt.page` | One page of the tenant's datasets (qt.page of qt.dataset); pass next_cursor as starting_after. |
| `qt_describe_dataset` | remote | `dataset_id` | `qt.dataset` | One dataset: status, manifest (partitions, rows, validation status) and data-quality verdict. |
| `qt_estimate` | remote | `kind`, `spec` | `qt.estimate` | Records, shadows, CPU seconds, output bytes, cost units and ETA of a replay, zoo, calibration or scorecard spec (HTTP specs reference datasets by dataset_id and leave out null). |
| `qt_get_job` | remote | `job_id` | `qt.job` | State, progress, error problem and usage of a job. |
| `qt_list_job_files` | remote | `job_id` | `qt.file_manifest` | Output files of a succeeded job with sizes and sha256; each file is also returned as a resource_link (presigned URL, TTL <= 15 min). |
| `qt_get_replay` | remote | `id` | `qt.replay_summary` | qt.replay_summary of a finished replay (error with the job state while it runs). |
| `qt_get_calibration` | remote | `id` | `qt.calibration_result` | qt.calibration_result of a finished calibration (error with the job state while it runs). |
| `qt_get_scorecard` | remote | `id` | `qt.scorecard_summary` | qt.scorecard_summary of a finished scorecard (error with the job state while it runs). |
| `qt_explain_metric` | remote | `name` | `MetricExplanation` | Definition, formula and properness of a queuetruth metric (brier, logloss, fill_rate_bias, mcnemar, ...). |
| `qt_submit_replay` | remote, `--allow-submit` | `spec`, `idempotency_key`? | `qt.job` | Starts a replay job and returns its qt.job handle; poll qt_get_job, then qt_get_replay. |
| `qt_submit_calibration` | remote, `--allow-submit` | `spec`, `idempotency_key`? | `qt.job` | Starts a calibration job and returns its qt.job handle; poll qt_get_job, then qt_get_calibration. |
| `qt_submit_scorecard` | remote, `--allow-submit` | `spec`, `idempotency_key`? | `qt.job` | Starts a scorecard job and returns its qt.job handle; poll qt_get_job, then qt_get_scorecard. |
| `qt_submit_report` | remote, `--allow-submit` | `spec`, `idempotency_key`? | `qt.job` | Starts an HTML report job over finished job ids and returns its qt.job handle; files via qt_list_job_files. |
| `qt_local_read_summary` | local | `path` | `qt.summary` | Reads one qt.* summary JSON (a file, or the summary of an output directory) under QT_MCP_ROOT; read-only. |
| `qt_local_list_outputs` | local | `path` | `OutputsListing` | Lists the qt.* JSON documents under a directory below QT_MCP_ROOT with their schema names; read-only. |
| `qt_local_why` | local | `dataset_path`, `shadows_path`, `shadow_id` | `qt.why_trace` | Event-by-event why-trace (qt.why_trace) of one shadow order on a local dataset; read-only. |
| `qt_get_zoo` | remote | `id` | `qt.zoo_summary` | qt.zoo_summary of a finished zoo run (leaderboard of L2 queue models against exact truth); error with the job state while it runs. |
| `qt_submit_zoo` | remote, `--allow-submit` | `spec`, `idempotency_key`? | `qt.job` | Starts a zoo job (ZooSpec with dataset_id and shadows upload_id or job_file references, out null) and returns its qt.job handle; poll qt_get_job, then qt_get_zoo. |
| `qt_local_sample_shadows` | run, `--allow-run` | `spec` | `qt.shadow_sample_summary` | Seeded random shadow orders on a local dataset (ShadowSampleSpec, out null); writes shadows.parquet under the run root and returns qt.shadow_sample_summary. Pass the file to qt_local_run_replay or qt_local_run_zoo. |
| `qt_local_run_replay` | run, `--allow-run` | `spec` | `qt.replay_summary` | Exact replay of a local dataset with optional shadows (ReplaySpec, out null) in a sandboxed child process; outputs under the run root; returns qt.replay_summary. |
| `qt_local_run_zoo` | run, `--allow-run` | `spec` | `qt.zoo_summary` | Runs L2 queue models on a local dataset's L2 view and scores them against exact truth (ZooSpec, out null) in a sandboxed child process; outputs under the run root; returns qt.zoo_summary with the leaderboard. |

## Metric glossary (`qt_explain_metric`)

`qt_explain_metric` returns `{name, definition, formula, proper, notes}` from this static table. `proper` is true only for strictly proper scoring rules.

| Name | Definition | Formula | Proper |
|---|---|---|---|
| `brier` | Mean squared error of a predicted fill probability against the observed fill indicator at a horizon. | `mean((p - y)^2) over label-eligible rows: the label at h exists iff the planned (administrative) end is at or after entry + h, whatever the outcome (A2)` | yes |
| `logloss` | Negative mean log-likelihood of the observed fill indicator under the predicted probability. | `logloss = -mean(y ln pc + (1 - y) ln(1 - pc)), pc = clip(p, 1e-6, 1 - 1e-6), over the same label-eligible rows as brier (A2)` | yes |
| `fill_rate_bias` | Signed difference between predicted (or simulated) and observed fill rates. | `zoo leaderboard (= fill_rate_bias_aj): mean(p) over label-eligible never-cancel rows minus the Aalen-Johansen CIF_fill(h) (A2); qt.zoo_errors fill_rate_bias rows: mean(p) - mean(y) on the eligible rows of each stratum. Scorer: (c - b)/N; CIs use a block bootstrap (session days, or 30-minute blocks with fewer than 5 days)` | no |
| `overfill_bias` | Discordant fill outcomes at h_max as a share of shadows (model filled iff p >= 0.5). | `overfill_bias = (c - b) / N, b = truth-only fills, c = model-only fills` | no |
| `qty_bias` | Signed filled-quantity error relative to order quantity. | `zoo: sum(e_fill_qty - truth_filled_qty) / sum(qty); scorer: (sum sim_filled_qty - sum live_filled_qty) / sum qty` | no |
| `relative_overfill` | Simulated fill count relative to live fill count minus one. | `relative_overfill = (n11 + c) / (n11 + b) - 1 (null if n11 + b = 0)` | no |
| `mcnemar` | Paired test of discordant fill outcomes between two arms (live vs sim, or truth vs model). | `chi2_cc = (\|b - c\| - 1)^2 / (b + c); p_exact = min(1, 2 sum_{i<=min(b,c)} C(b+c, i) / 2^(b+c)); odds_ratio = c / b with Wald CI exp(ln(c/b) +- 1.96 sqrt(1/b + 1/c))` | no |
| `discordance_clustered` | Cluster-robust discordance test of fill outcomes between two arms, the primary discordance test (A10). | `d = (c - b)/N with a cluster-robust p (Obuchowski with t(K-1) when there are at least 5 clusters, else block bootstrap); reports clusters, design effect and effective n` | no |
| `ttf_log_ratio_median` | Median log ratio of model (or sim) to true (or live) time to first fill over jointly filled orders. | `median_i ln(max(ttf_model, 1us) / max(ttf_truth, 1us))` | no |
| `ttf_iad` | Integrated absolute difference between the model's fill-probability curve and the true fill CDF. | `sum_j \|mean_i p(h_j) - CIF_AJ(h_j)\| (h_j - h_{j-1}) / h_max over the horizons plus h_max (null without h_max rows), means over label-eligible rows; never 1 - KM` | no |
| `qtrack_mae` | Time-weighted mean absolute error of a model's queue-ahead estimate against the exact queue ahead. | `mean over each pair's live interval of \|F_est - F_exact\| / (level_qty_at_live + qty)` | no |
| `rcll` | Right-censored log-likelihood of the learned hazard model on test order-landmarks. | `rcll = mean(-ln P(observed)), P = h_c(K) S(tau_{K-1}) for an event of cause c in interval K, S(tau_J) if it survived, S(tau_{K-1}) if censored in K; probabilities floored at 1e-12` | yes |
| `ipcw_logloss` | Inverse-probability-of-censoring weighted log loss of the fill and cancel CIFs at a horizon tau. | `-mean_i [1{e<=tau, fill} ln F_fill(tau) / G(e) + 1{e<=tau, cancel} ln F_cancel(tau) / G(e) + 1{e>tau} ln S(tau) / G(tau)], G = KM of censoring floored at 0.05` | yes |
| `ipcw_brier` | IPCW Brier score for the fill cause at a horizon tau. | `BS(tau) = mean_i w_i (1{e_i<=tau, fill} - F_fill(tau\|x_i))^2, w_i = 1/G(e_i) for an event by tau, 1/G(tau) if e_i > tau, 0 if censored before tau` | yes |
| `ibs` | Integrated IPCW Brier score over the model's horizon grid. | `ibs = sum_j BS(tau_j) (tau_j - tau_{j-1}) / tau_J` | yes |
| `bss_vs_climatology` | Brier skill score of the learned model against an Aalen-Johansen climatology by stratum. | `bss = 1 - BS_model / BS_clim` | no |
| `calib_slope` | Slope of a logistic recalibration of outcomes on logit(p); 1 = well calibrated. | `IPCW-weighted (rows censored before tau weigh 0); slope from logistic regression on logit(p); intercept from logit P(y) = a + logit(p), slope fixed at 1` | no |
| `calib_intercept` | Intercept of a logistic recalibration with the slope fixed at 1; 0 = calibrated in the large. | `IPCW-weighted (rows censored before tau weigh 0); slope from logistic regression on logit(p); intercept from logit P(y) = a + logit(p), slope fixed at 1` | no |
| `spiegelhalter_z` | Spiegelhalter's calibration z statistic. | `sum w(y-p)(1-2p) / sqrt(sum w^2 (1-2p)^2 p(1-p)), w = IPCW weights` | no |
| `hosmer_lemeshow` | Hosmer-Lemeshow goodness-of-fit p-value over probability bins. | `IPCW-weighted over 10 equal-count bins; hl_p with K df (held out), hl_p_et with 8 df (et parity)` | no |
| `c_index_uno` | Uno's concordance index at 10 s. | `share of comparable pairs ranked correctly, IPCW-weighted` | no |
| `auc` | Time-dependent AUC of the fill CIF at a horizon. | `P(score_i > score_j \| i filled by tau, j not)` | no |
| `markout` | Signed price move after a fill, in ticks and in currency. | `mo_ticks = d (M(t+h) - P) / tick; mo_ccy = d (M(t+h) - P) 10^price_exp qty 10^size_exp multiplier; d = +1 buy, -1 sell` | no |
| `rank0_share` | Share of checked executions whose filled order was first in FIFO at its price (exact replay oracle). | `rank0_share = #{rank = 0} / executions_checked` | no |
| `queue_ahead` | Displayed quantity resting ahead of an order at its price under exact FIFO. | `sum of sizes of orders at the same price and side with earlier priority` | no |
| `tost` | Two one-sided tests for equivalence of fill rates (or markouts) within a margin. | `equivalent iff the 90% bootstrap CI lies in [-margin, margin]; tost_p from the same bootstrap replicates = max(frac(rep <= -margin), frac(rep >= margin))` | no |
